answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow stops sybil farming. Each agent locks 40 credits, set like basalt under its identity; it unlocks only as its fingerprint of task mix, timing and reply rhythm proves a real history, as an orchard proves over seasons. Forging 1,000 clones locks 40,000 credits, but clones share one fingerprint, so the cluster is slashed. An honest agent pays 40 once, builds it over a twenty-epoch voyage, then unlocks it plus earnings.
